questions.question: Port, situated at the head of the Gulf of Kuchchh has been developed as a major port to cater to the needs of western and north-western parts of the country and also to reduce the pressure at Mumbai port.
questions.questionHtml: Port, situated at the head of the Gulf of Kuchchh has been developed as a major port to cater to the needs of western and north-western parts of the country and also to reduce the pressure at Mumbai port.
questions.solution: Kandla Port situated at the head of Gulf of Kuchchh has been developed as a major port to cater to the needs of western and north western parts of the country and also to reduce the pressure at Mumbai port. The port is specially designed to receive large quantities of petroleum and petroleum products and fertiliser. The offshore terminal at Vadinar has been developed to reduce the pressure at Kandla port. Kandla Port Trust was renamed as Deendayal Port Trust with effect from 25th of September, 2017.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an eastern coast port?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is an example of an eastern coast port?
questions.solution:
India's coastline is divided into the eastern and western coasts.

· Eastern coast ports: Chennai, Visakhapatnam, Paradip, Kolkata

· Western coast ports: Mumbai, Mormugao, New Mangalore, Kandla

Since Chennai Port is located on the eastern coast of India, option 2 (Chennai Port) is the correct answer.

options.text: The government can call any airport a major airport just by notification.
options.html: The government can call any airport a major airport just by notification.

options.text: The government will club together profit-making and loss-making airports.
options.html: The government will club together profit-making and loss-making airports.

options.text: The government can offer airports as a package in PPP mode to prospective bidders.

options.text: A major airport is one which has an annual traffic of minimum 35 lakh passengers.

questions.solution: The AERA Amendment Act, 2021 allows the government to designate airports as major airports through a notification and club airports for PPP. However, 35 lakh passengers per annum remains the standard definition of a major airport and is not an amendment.

questions.question: Which of the following Indian states has the least number of operational airports as of 2022?

questions.solution: As of 2022, Mizoram, being a smaller northeastern state with challenging terrain, had the least number of operational airports among the given options. The state's geographical constraints and limited infrastructure contribute to its minimal airport connectivity.

questions.question: When was air transport nationalised in India?
questions.questionHtml: When was air transport nationalised in India?
questions.solution:
• Air transport in India was nationalised in 1953 with the passing of the Air Corporations Act.

• Two corporations - Indian Airlines and Air India - were created to manage domestic and international air travel, respectively.

questions.question: Through which routes is the majority of India's international trade carried out?
questions.questionHtml: Through which routes is the majority of India's international trade carried out?
questions.solution:
India's international trade is primarily conducted through sea routes and airways:

· Sea transport accounts for more than 70% of India's trade.

· Air transport is used for high-value, perishable, and urgent shipments.

questions.question: In November 2022, the Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved the naming of Greenfield Airport at Hollongi, Itanagar as:
questions.questionHtml: In November 2022, the Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved the naming of Greenfield Airport at Hollongi, Itanagar as:
questions.solution: The decision to name the greenfield airport at Hollongi, Itanagar, as "Donyi Polo Airport" was made by the Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. "Donyi Polo" refers to the indigenous belief system followed by the Tani communities in Arunachal Pradesh. It is a traditional animist faith that venerates the sun (Donyi) and the moon (Polo) as symbols of divine entities.

questions.question: Which of the following airports is being built as India's first 'carbon-neutral airport'?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following airports is being built as India's first 'carbon-neutral airport'?
questions.solution:
· Leh's Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport is set to become India's first carbon-neutral airport, as part of the Airports Authority of India's (AAI) green initiative.

· The airport will achieve this through:

o Solar power plants (reducing reliance on fossil fuels).

o Energy-efficient infrastructure (LED lighting, improved insulation).

o Sustainable waste and water management systems.

o Carbon offset programs (like tree plantation in the region).

· Located in the ecologically sensitive Ladakh region, this project aligns with India's climate commitments.

questions.question: As of June 2023, which of the following is India's largest airport in terms of total passengers?
questions.questionHtml: As of June 2023, which of the following is India's largest airport in terms of total passengers?

options.text: Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport of Mumbai
options.html: Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport of Mumbai

options.text: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport
options.html: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport

questions.solution:
As of June 2023, and consistently for several years prior, Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) in Delhi has been India's largest and busiest airport in terms of total passenger traffic (both domestic and international).

Explanation of Other Options:

• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport (AMD), Ahmedabad: A major international airport but significantly smaller than Delhi in passenger traffic.

• Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (BOM), Mumbai: Typically the second busiest airport in India.

• Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport (CCU), Kolkata: A major airport in Eastern India but handles fewer passengers than Delhi or Mumbai.

Further insights:

• Indira Gandhi International Airport serves as a major hub for domestic and international flights in India.

• Its passenger numbers have consistently placed it among the busiest airports in Asia and the world.

• Airport rankings can fluctuate, but Delhi has maintained its top position in India for a considerable period.

questions.question: Under the National Waterways Act, 2016, how many inland waterways have been declared as 'national waterways'?
questions.questionHtml: Under the National Waterways Act, 2016, how many inland waterways have been declared as 'national waterways'?
questions.solution: The Government of India, through the National Waterways Act, 2016, enacted on April 12, 2016, declared 111 waterways as National Waterways. This legislative measure aimed to enhance and streamline the development and management of inland water transport infrastructure across the country.
